name: Card Blueprints
description: Card Blueprints, published by Cassidy Rice, turns a date of birth into Cardology coordinates: the fixed playing-card birth card in a 52-card pattern language. This is not fortune-telling and not tarot. The free skill is a deep-link calculator. The optional paid next steps are the $13 One Question Reading — one question, read from the birth card and the year, written within about a minute — and the 22-page computed Blueprint Report, $129 alone or $297 with a 45-minute consultation. This card is a discovery manifest; skills are public HTTPS pages, not an A2A JSON-RPC task server.
